templates.why_chosen: Two framed chassis photos (24-bay front, 12-port back) sit beside a fully labelled internal diagram of one switch fanning into two identical 12-SSD pipelines, at nesting depth 5, the deepest figure in this set.
templates.what_to_learn: Frame a chassis photo with a thin border so it reads as one panel, not decoration, and reserve the fullest label depth (nesting depth 5 here) for the paper's own dual-pipeline internal view; avoid this figure's own weakness of collapsing 24 SSDs to bare ellipses with only a few labelled.
